description: Hydrogenerate: Open Source Python Tool To Estimate Hydropower Generation Time-series is a software deposit deposited in DOE Office of Scientific and Technical Information (OSTI) Repository by its authors Bhaskar Mitra, Juan Gallego-Calderon (Idaho National Lab. (INL), Idaho Falls, ID (United States)). Hydropower is one of the most mature forms of renewable energy generation. The United States (US) has almost 103 GW of installed, with 80 GW of conventional generation and 23 GW of pumped hydropower [1]. Moreover, the potential for future development on Non-Powered Dams is up to 10 GW. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked.
